rules.description: WordPress 470 (Empresa); aceita exatamente um argumento p=ID ou page_id=ID, com parâmetros auxiliares, e remove a query no destino.
rules.expression: ((http.host in {"newtractor.com.br" "www.newtractor.com.br"} and http.request.uri.path in {"/" "/index.php"} and len(http.request.uri.args["p"]) == 1 and any(http.request.uri.args["p"][*] == "470") and not has_key(http.request.uri.args, "page_id")) or (http.host in {"newtractor.com.br" "www.newtractor.com.br"} and http.request.uri.path in {"/" "/index.php"} and len(http.request.uri.args["page_id"]) == 1 and any(http.request.uri.args["page_id"][*] == "470") and not has_key(http.request.uri.args, "p")))
